name: Fatebreaker splashes 15% of Anomaly Spike damage, and only with the talent (#12293, #12252)
contract: Fatebreaker 503835 reads "Damage dealt by Anomaly Spikes now deals an additional $s1% of its damage dealt to the target and up to $504725i enemies within $504725a1 yds of them as Chromatic Damage", $s1 = EffectBasePoints 14 + DieSides 1 = 15. Its only effect is aura 354 (SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_PROC_PERCENT_EVENT) with EffectTriggerSpell 504725, and the core acts on aura 354 only for eight hard-coded ids, so the talent did nothing. Meanwhile Anomaly Spike 503826 effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL 504725 for every caster, and 504725 is SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE with EffectBasePoints 0 + DieSides 1 = 1 on TARGET_DEST_TARGET_ENEMY / TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY, EffectRadiusIndex 8 = 5 yd, MaxTargets 5, so every spike splashed a 1-damage Fatebreaker even without the talent. 504725 already carries SPELL_ATTR2_CANT_CRIT, SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS, SPELL_ATTR4_IGNORE_DAMAGE_TAKEN_MODIFIERS and SPELL_ATTR6_IGNORE_CASTER_DAMAGE_MODIFIERS, i.e. a resolved-amount carrier. The golem stands 10 yd from the Chronomancer and the bystander 12 yd, inside the 5 yd area centred on the golem. Control: an untalented spike casts no 504725. With the talent, the next spike must hit the bystander with 504725 for 15% of the damage the spike dealt to the golem (0.14-0.16 for integer rounding), and the same area includes the golem. Before the fix the control sees one 504725 hit and the talented hit is 1 damage.
